title: Selection of the angular speed of rotating waves in segregated reaction-diffusion systems with asymmetric competition
summary: We investigate the existence of segregated rotating waves, arising in the singular limit of competition-diffusion systems of the type \[ \partial_t u_i -\partial_{xx} u_i = f(u_i)-βu_i \sum_{j \neq i} a_{ij} u_j,\qquad x\in\mathbb{S}^1,\ t>0, 1\le i,j\le k, \] as $β\to+\infty$. Here $k\ge3$, the reaction $f$ is of Fisher-KPP (logistic) type, and the competition coefficients $a_{ij}>0$ are not necessarily symmetric.
